correctness.rationale: Fix L>0, ε>0. The source axial volume Gini constant equals 246/875, and normalized boundary masses satisfy α=a/D>0, β=b/(2D), γ=ε/(3D)=α/(3S), S=sqrt(L²+1)>1. Hence β=1−α(1+1/(3S)), α<3S/(2S+1)<3/2. Substitution in g=α+(2/3)β−(2/3)α²−αβ−(2/5)β² yields g−4/15=α[6S²+2S−α(3S²−3S+2)]/(45S²). The bracket is strictly > (3S²+13S−6)/2>0. As ε→0, α→0, β→1 so g→4/15 and transverse penalty 2sqrt(1+ε²)/L→2/L, giving unattained inf_U=4/15+2/L. Exact rational difference 246/875−4/15=38/2625 means the projection-diameter proof works for some positive ε iff L>2/(38/2625)=2625/19. For L at/below threshold no ε satisfies these TWO inequalities, not an impossibility theorem for the true geometric distance sign. Independent rational-symbolic checker reconfirmed the polynomial identity, positivity reduction and threshold. Presentation caution: assigned RESULT.md has literal doubled backslashes in mathematical command strings (e.g. before varepsilon, Delta, frac); proof was interpreted after decoding its intended formula, and source rendering requires authorized fix before publication.
